answer: Sequential Challenge Ledger. Each identity gets one fresh, randomly generated challenge whose answer must be derived from the prior block's onyx hash, making any answer valid for exactly one identity and unrepeatable elsewhere. A new identity therefore cannot reuse a solved challenge; it must pay to obtain a distinct valid proof, priced as live compute plus the risk of holding stale nectar-encoded seeds. Registration throttles to one proven answer per epoch, so cloning cost scales with real work, and identities failing the chain halt in a closed haven with no further participation.
